metadata.name: pocketlab-runbook-validation-gates
metadata.title: Pocket Lab Tier 7C Runbook Validation Gates

gates.title: Runbook schema and catalog validation
gates.message: All runbooks satisfy the Tier 7A schema and typed-operation catalog validation.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: No direct shell or script execution in runbooks
gates.message: No direct shell/script execution fields were found. Runbooks preserve typed-operation-only execution semantics.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Approval and policy gate
gates.message: High-impact and approval-gated runbooks include enterprise approval metadata.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Evidence coverage gate
gates.message: All runbooks declare operation events, audit events, and workflow journal evidence.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Typed operation contract evidence gate
gates.message: All runbook steps reference typed operations with API and NATS evidence metadata.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Timeout and bounded execution gate
gates.message: Runbook timeout metadata is bounded within Tier 7C guidance.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Simple Mode language gate
gates.message: Simple Mode runbook labels avoid the configured technical terms.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Generated documentation freshness gate
gates.message: Generated runbook documentation is present for the current catalog.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Retired architecture token gate
gates.message: No retired architecture tokens were found in Tier 7 runbook paths.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.

gates.title: Rollback and safety review gate
gates.message: High-impact runbooks include rollback and safety metadata suitable for review.
gates.remediation: Review the generated validation report and update runbooks/*.yaml.
